runtime/application#

The native layer under terminal/mode, terminal/screen, terminal/session: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under terminal/mode, terminal/screen, terminal/session: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.
